title: British-Style Chicken Curry
description: A classic British-inspired chicken curry made with tender chicken, flavorful spices, and a hint of British charm.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of kissed oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the British curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the yogurt and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
